prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: internal high-fidelity desktop homepage first-viewport decision comp for Senses Montessori School
Primary request: Design one polished, shippable-looking desktop web homepage first viewport for the direction “Correntes de Curiosidade,” translated from suminagashi fluid ink into a calm, bright, warm Montessori school interface. This must unmistakably read as a real website UI, not a poster or moodboard.
Input images: Image 1 is the original Senses logo; reproduce it faithfully and visibly in the header without redrawing or restyling it. Image 2 is authentic Senses school photography; use it as the documentary school-photo content, preserving its recognizable prepared Montessori environment and natural light while cropping it artfully into the composition.
Structure and composition: landscape 3:2 desktop viewport, approximately 1536×1024. A restrained single-line header sits within the warm paper canvas: original Senses logo at left; small Portuguese nav links “A Senses”, “Método”, “Programas”, “Nossa casa”, plus “English” at right. Below, create an asymmetric editorial hero that is not a generic left-copy/right-image split. The headline is the dominant focal point, with body and two clear CTAs grouped beneath. A generous documentary photo field enters from the upper-right and reaches deep into the lower half. One continuous, elegant plum-and-rose suminagashi ink current physically links and partly frames the thesis and the photo, threading behind or around content with convincing liquid marbling, fine capillary edges, pools, and negative-space eddies. Let the current create hierarchy and spatial flow, not surface decoration. Allow a subtle glimpse of the next section at the bottom edge to prove this is a webpage.
Typography: sophisticated warm editorial serif for the large headline, restrained humanist sans serif for body, nav, and buttons; excellent legibility; confident whitespace; no eyebrow label above the heading.
Color palette: warm paper #FFF9F0 dominant; plum #7C3E66 primary brand anchor; rose #D2B0B1 secondary ink; deep blue #263F55 for body text and restrained contrast. Bright and warm, calm but playful.
Text (verbatim, render exactly with accents and punctuation):
Headline: “Toda criança nasce cientista.”
Body: “Uma escola Montessori bilíngue onde ciência, afeto e autonomia fazem parte de cada descoberta.”
Primary CTA: “Conheça a Senses”
Secondary CTA: “Agende uma visita”
UI details: primary CTA as a substantial plum button; secondary CTA as a quiet text or outline action. Keep controls clearly interactive and navigation restrained. Fine paper tactility is acceptable, but surfaces remain clean and bright.
Constraints: use only the supplied verified copy and nav labels; no invented programs, credentials, rankings, testimonials, outcomes, age ranges, statistics, or admissions claims. Keep all Portuguese text exact and readable. Preserve the original Senses logo. The photo must feel documentary and authentic, never like glossy stock photography.
Avoid: generic split hero, cold blue luxury mood, excessive cards, card grids, gradients, glassmorphism, decorative blobs, rainbow preschool styling, cartoons, doodles, stock-photo polish, aggressive marketing, oversized pills, fake browser chrome, watermarks, extra headings, extra claims, misspelled text.
